title: Chapter 422: Seriously Injured Tan Lang
content:
Chapter 422: Seriously Injured Tan Lang

Wang Shuo continued to kill the enemy.

Suddenly, the opponent's supreme commander, Tan Lang, came down in person.

Wang Shuo was not afraid, but slightly excited.

As a high-level warrior, Tan Lang's strength was unquestionable. He did not turn into a beast.

Instead, he kept a human wolf head.

Hmm! Werewolf!

He was wearing armor and holding double hook weapons in both hands. The monsters around him automatically made way for him.

"Who are you? I don't kill nameless people."

Seeing Wang Shuo so brave, Tan Lang wanted to find out Wang Shuo's origins.

"Hehe, I'm just a nobody, otherwise, don't kill me?"

Wang Shuo sneered and did not stop killing.

Seeing that the opponent ignored him, Tan Lang let out a long howl and asked the monsters around him to retreat.

Leaving the battlefield to Wang Shuo and himself.

He wanted to personally put an end to this guy who despised him.

In the field, there were no other monsters around Wang Shuo, and he began to deal with Tan Lang seriously.

Wang Shuo took a quick step forward, thrusting the spear in his hand forward, and a dragon-shaped phantom came straight out.

"Turning into a dragon and striking."

This was a test of the opponent's strength.

Greed crossed his two hooks in front of his chest, and pushed forward again, directly slashing the dragon-shaped phantom.

Seeing the opponent's nonchalant look, it was obvious that he had not tried his best.

Wang Shuo could not help but be cautious, as the opponent was qualified to be his opponent.

Wang Shuo's biggest advantage was the attribute bonus brought by the Shura suit, but he was still one level lower than Greed.

The two offset each other, and it was a 50-50 split.

At the beginning, Greedy Wolf had the upper hand, but the more he fought, the more he felt something was wrong. The opponent seemed to have endless energy, and all kinds of moves were seamlessly connected, like a storm, and Greedy Wolf began to switch from offense to defense.

In the end, he became passive and could not find a chance to counterattack.

Greedy Wolf was horrified.

Finally, after several rounds of fighting, Wang Shuo felt that he had accumulated enough anger, and then launched the ultimate move "Shura Slash" again.

Seeing the giant light blade falling from the sky again, Tan Lang's heart was like a storm.

He quickly sacrificed a tortoise shield and raised his hands above his head.

This tortoise shield is an epic defensive shield. The main reason why he maintains his human form is that he can use weapons.

The light blade slashed on the tortoise shield and directly shattered it. Behind Tan Lang, there was a long gully.

Because the tortoise shield offset most of the damage of Shura Slash, Tan Lang did not die on the spot, but he was also seriously injured at this time.

He immediately fled the battlefield and fled in a hurry with his men.

In this battle, he had never thought of attacking the Dahuai Territory. He was seriously injured at this time and just left.

The army of monsters retreated like a tide, and Wang Shuo on the battlefield was a little confused.

Even if the main general was injured, there was no need for the whole army to retreat!

Seeing this, the soldiers on the city gate tower immediately burst into thunderous cheers.

The monster retreated, and Wang Shuo could just make Liu Hong a dumpling.

So, Wang Shuo's Red Flame Legion immediately came to the city wall and reorganized the formation.

On the other side of the Great Wall, Liu Hong had no idea that the monster had retreated.

Zhao Bangde did not advance rashly, but fought a defensive battle in a conventional manner.

Liu Hong was not in a hurry. He was enjoying fine wine and delicious food at the command center. He made up his mind to let the monster consume more of the manpower of the Dahuai Territory.

"Report, a large number of enemy troops appeared on the right side of our army."

Hearing the spy's report, Liu Hong's hand holding the grapes trembled leisurely.

But he was not too panicked.

At this time, wanting to take the risk of detouring to attack his base camp was simply courting death.

Little did he know, is it the reason for a lone army to go deep into the enemy's territory?
